run_generate_video: run the generate_video function with a prompt, model path, lora path, and output file
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point with --prompt, --model_path, --lora_path, --output_file, and --fps arguments
test_lora_inference: test the lora inference pipeline by generating a video from a text prompt using CogVideoX and LoRA weights
run_cogvideox_pipeline: run the CogVideoXPipeline with LoRA adapter weights loaded and set for video generation
run_export_to_video: run export_to_video to save generated frames to an MP4 file at a specified FPS
